design_name: Design A (approved) -- natural population, no redraw, no distribution matching
primary_claim: Does the frozen reliability framework generalize to previously unseen proteins drawn from the frozen eligibility population (Q1), not to a PROBE-distribution-matched population (Q2)?
model_selection_rule: ranks {1,3,5,7,9} of PROBE published Table 5 leaderboard (Mistral Large 123B, Qwen2.5 72B, Gemma-4 31B, Mixtral 8x7B, Mistral 7B) -- mechanical rule from already-published PROBE numbers, fixed before any held-out data was examined; leave-one-out verified no single model is load-bearing
p5_exclusion_reason: P5 is a closed-set selection task (choose from a fixed, namespace-generic candidate list hardcoded in llm_prompting.py), structurally different from the open-ended generation of P1-P4; none of the three frozen score components (n_models, max_prompt_consistency, rago_support) use P5 data; omitting it changes nothing the framework uses
blast_database: RAGO/pool_blastdb (built from ADAPT's 25,460-protein pool, pool_proteins.fasta) -- frozen, unchanged, verified zero overlap with held-out 243
go_obo_n_terms_note: Corrected from a previously recorded 48,291 to the verified direct count of 48,321 '[Term]' stanzas (includes 10,058 obsolete terms). File hash is IDENTICAL before and after this correction (923645000afcb1df) -- the OBO file itself was never modified; this was a documentation bookkeeping correction only, not a data-integrity issue.
eligibility_criterion: >=3 total experimental GO terms (any namespace, pooled) AND non-empty UniProt FUNCTION comment; identical to the rule used to build the ADAPT pool being excluded; NOT changed after observing the held-out annotation-distribution shift
excluded_populations: every accession in PROBE's 1,000-protein benchmark UNION ADAPT's 25,460-protein training pool -- verified zero overlap
ecoli_shortfall: target was 62; entire fresh eligible E. coli pool (2,495 accessions) was exhaustively checked; only 55 qualified. Accepted as final per Design A -- NOT backfilled by relaxing the threshold, NOT backfilled by reallocating slots from another organism. Verified (via exclude-ecoli-entirely sensitivity check) that the shortfall is not the cause of the annotation-distribution shift (effect size unchanged: Cohen's d -0.646 with ecoli excluded vs -0.645 with ecoli included).
zebrafish_excluded_reason: 0% empirical yield in feasibility testing; eligible pool for zebrafish was already essentially exhausted by PROBE+ADAPT
sampling_procedure: per organism: enumerate full current reviewed UniProt accession list -> exclude PROBE union ADAPT -> shuffle with random.Random(42) -> sequentially check qualification in that fixed order -> keep first N_target qualifiers (or all qualifiers if the pool is exhausted before reaching N_target, as occurred for E. coli). Already executed in full; the drawn set is FINAL -- no redraw, substitution, top-up, or rebalancing.
bootstrap_method: resample N_heldout proteins with replacement from the 243 held-out proteins; pool all claims from resampled proteins; compute precision-at-10%-coverage on the pooled pseudo-sample; 95% CI = 2.5th/97.5th percentiles across B>=1000 replicates
calls_formula: 243 proteins x 3 namespaces x 5 models x 4 prompts
no_retuning_statement: No held-out result may be used to retune prompts, models, reliability score weights, BLAST thresholds, score thresholds, or eligibility criteria. A negative or weak held-out result is a valid scientific finding and will NOT trigger post-hoc tuning or a redraw.
open_world_annotation_limitation: The held-out population has substantially sparser experimental GO annotation than PROBE's dev set, particularly for biological_process (BP presence 67.1% held-out vs 93.8% PROBE; Cohen's d=-0.623). Incomplete experimental ground truth can cause biologically correct but not-yet-curated predictions to be counted as false negatives in scoring. This is reported as a potential evaluation limitation, not a proven conservative bias. BP-specific secondary results are particularly susceptible; CC-specific results are the least affected (presence 88.5% held-out vs 75.8% PROBE).
scripts_not_yet_created: heldout_query_proteins.fasta (raw sequences for the 243 held-out proteins -- required for BLAST retrieval, not required for P1-P4 LLM generation calls)
heldout_rag_candidates.json (BLAST retrieval output against the frozen pool_blastdb -- required to compute rago_support at scoring time)
scripts/llm_prompting_heldout.py (frozen copy of llm_prompting.py restricted to the 5 rule-models and P1-P4 only, pointed at the 243-protein held-out set)
